requestBody.description: UTF-8 CSV with a header row. Required columns: product_code, batch_no, on_hand, expiry_date (YYYY-MM-DD), unit_cost_paise. Optional (blank = 0): reserved, allocated, safety_stock, quarantined. Max 1 MB.

post.description:
Record a physical count: writes a VerificationEvent, sets last_verified_at, and a
count that differs from on_hand replaces it.

Create a shortage in the caller's org. The hub computes the shortfall and runs the
first match, so the shortage comes back MATCHING; with `status: DRAFT` it comes back
DRAFT and unmatched (a chat draft saved for later, S17).

get.description: The caller's own org's shortages, newest first.

post.description:
DRAFT -> OPEN (business-rules §8: the requester confirms a chat draft), then the first
match run, so it comes back MATCHING. 409 `invalid_transition` unless DRAFT.
Allowed from OPEN, MATCHING or AWAITING_DECISION; otherwise 409 `invalid_transition`.
Manual re-run while the shortage is OPEN or MATCHING; otherwise 409.

get.description:
Any user of the requester's org: eligible candidates by rank, then rejected ones with
every failed gate's reason.

Any user of the requester's org: the shortage's newest recommendation, which is the
one waiting for a decision (PENDING or ESCALATED) while there is one, else the last one
decided or expired. 404 if none has been made yet. Same redaction as
GET /recommendations/{id}: a hospital source's cost is never shown.

The shortage's trail in the caller's own org, oldest first: the shortage, its match
runs, source requests, recommendations, purchase orders, shipments, receipts,
reconciliations and received batches. `reason_source` says whether a user typed the
reason (USER) or the hub recorded it (SYSTEM). 403 for another org's shortage.

post.description:
For services/iot-ingest only (ingest token, scope `telemetry.write`). Idempotent:
a reading whose (device_id, ts) is already stored counts as a duplicate.

get.description: The caller's own org's devices, with last_seen and battery.

post.description:
Put one of the caller's org's devices (403 for another org's) on a shipment the org
carries (403 if another org carries it; 409 while it is CREATED and has no carrier), or
take it off with `shipment_id: null`. Its new readings are linked to the shipment, and
sent as `coldchain.reading`, while the shipment is ASSIGNED, PICKED_UP or IN_TRANSIT.
409 if the shipment has arrived or already carries another device.

get.description:
`incoming`: requests the caller's org is asked to supply. `outgoing`: requests sent
for the caller's org's shortages. Newest first; optional `status` and `shortage_id`.

post.description:
Source org only. Places TENTATIVE holds on the source's batches (earliest expiry
first) and moves the request to TENTATIVE_HOLD. 409 `conflict` if the stock no longer
covers it: the request is then EXPIRED ("Stock changed before acceptance.") and matching
re-runs. 409 `invalid_transition` if it is not REQUESTED, or its deadline has passed.

Source org only; the reason is optional. Matching re-runs without this org for the
shortage. 409 `invalid_transition` if it is not REQUESTED, or its deadline has passed.

A 60-second ticket that opens GET /events/stream as the caller (`?ticket=`), because
a browser EventSource cannot send an Authorization header.

get.description:
Server-sent events for the caller's org: only events whose `org_ids` include it.

Each message is `id: <seq>` and `data: <envelope>`, where the envelope is
`{id, type, occurred_at, org_ids, data}` (api-and-events.md, Events). A comment line
(`: heartbeat`) is sent after 15 seconds without events. Reconnect with the last `id` as the
`Last-Event-ID` header or `last_event_id` query parameter to replay what was missed; if too
much was missed, the stream sends `event: reset` instead, and the client should refetch.
The stream closes after 15 minutes; reconnect with a new ticket.
The caller's org's subscriptions, oldest first. Secrets are never listed.

post.description:
Subscribe the caller's org: events of `event_types` addressed to it are POSTed to

delete.description: Own org's subscription only (403 otherwise). Its pending deliveries stop.

get.description:
Any user of the requester's org (403 otherwise). A hospital source's cost is never
shown, only supplier costs.

post.description:
PENDING or ESCALATED -> APPROVED. Transfer: holds become FIRM, requests CONFIRMED,
one shipment per source. Buy: a purchase order is sent. The shortage -> IN_FULFILLMENT.
409 if already decided, or if it (or a hold) has expired: it is then expired and
matching re-runs.

PENDING or ESCALATED -> REJECTED (reason optional). Releases every hold and re-runs
matching. 409 if already decided or expired.
PENDING -> ESCALATED, notifying every APPROVER of the org. 409 otherwise.

get.description: Purchase orders sent to the caller's supplier org, newest first; optional `status`.

post.description:
SENT -> ACKNOWLEDGED. Only the supplier the order went to (403 otherwise); 409 from
any other status.

SENT or ACKNOWLEDGED -> REJECTED (reason optional). The shortage goes back to
MATCHING and matching re-runs without this supplier; 409 from any other status.

ACKNOWLEDGED -> DISPATCHED, creating the shipment from the supplier to the hospital
(`shipment_id`). 409 unless the order has been acknowledged.

get.description:
One shipment with its route geometry, status history and last driver location (only
a ping recorded since the current assignment; none while CREATED). 403 unless the
caller's org is involved (or it is unassigned and the caller is a logistics org).

post.description:
CREATED -> ASSIGNED with one of the caller's org's drivers and vehicles (403 for
another org's). A cold-chain shipment needs a cold-chain vehicle: 400 with the reason
otherwise. Stores the road route, its geometry and the ETA (OSRM, haversine fallback).
409 unless CREATED, and 409 `conflict` when the held stock is at more than one of the
source's facilities (one pickup per shipment). Any device on it comes off.

ASSIGNED -> CREATED, by the carrier org (403 otherwise); 409 unless ASSIGNED. Any
device on it comes off.

The assigned driver only (403 otherwise): ASSIGNED -> PICKED_UP -> IN_TRANSIT ->
DELIVERED, one step at a time (409 otherwise). PICKED_UP draws down the source's
on_hand and consumes its FIRM hold; a batch recording less than its hold is drawn down
only by what it records (never below 0).

A GPS ping from the assigned driver's phone (403 otherwise), while ASSIGNED,
PICKED_UP or IN_TRANSIT (409 otherwise). Sent to the shipment's orgs as
`shipment.location`.

get.description: The caller's own org's drivers.
The caller's own org's vehicles.

post.description:
A stop order for one of the caller's org's drivers over unassigned shipments,
starting now: each pickup before its drop, each drop by its shortage's `required_by`,
each cold-chain shipment within the cold-chain ride limit (business-rules.md §4).
Shipments that cannot fit come back in `infeasible` with a reason. Writes nothing.
403 for another org's driver, vehicle or a shipment the caller's org cannot see; 409
unless every shipment is CREATED.

Plans again and assigns the driver and vehicle to every feasible shipment (as
POST /shipments/{id}/assign does, with its checks and audit rows), with each stop's
`planned_at` and the ETA from the plan. All or nothing; 409 `conflict` if no shipment
fits, `invalid_transition` unless every shipment is CREATED.

The receiving org records what arrived (business-rules.md §9): DELIVERED ->
RECONCILED, the accepted stock becomes a new batch in its inventory, and once every
shipment of the shortage has a receipt the shortage is reconciled (RESOLVED, or
PARTIALLY_RESOLVED with a residual shortage that starts matching). 403 for any other
org; 409 unless DELIVERED; 400 if received > expected, accepted + rejected ≠ received,
a shipment with an excursion on record has no inspection note, or accepted stock has
no expiry.

The caller's own org's forecasts, one per product with a stored forecast (catalog

Forecast now instead of waiting for the nightly job. A platform admin runs every

AiColdChainOut.title: AiColdChainOut

Cold-chain record of a shipment. S15 adds excursion events; until then `events` is
empty and `has_open_excursion` false (business-rules.md §11).

shortfall.title: Shortfall
shortfall.description: Hub-computed max(0, qty_required - qty_local_usable); never taken as input.

residual_shortages.title: Residual Shortages
residual_shortages.description: Shortages opened for what a short delivery left (parent_shortage_id).

AiShortageOut.title: AiShortageOut
AiShortageOut.description: GET /shortages/{id} plus what hangs off it, as the requester's org sees it.

shipment_ids.title: Shipment Ids
shipment_ids.description: Unassigned (CREATED) shipments the caller's org may see; repeats count once.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA time zone for the times in the reasons, e.g. Asia/Kolkata.

message.title: Message
message.description: business-rules.md §13 wording for the approved type.

held_qty.title: Held Qty
held_qty.description: Units under active source-request holds; counted as reserved.

BatchUpdate.title: BatchUpdate
BatchUpdate.description: Partial update. Product and facility are fixed; omitted or null fields are unchanged.

offered_qty.title: Offered Qty
offered_qty.description: Supplier sources: the offer's available qty.

landed_cost_paise.title: Landed Cost Paise
landed_cost_paise.description: Eligible supplier candidates only; never shown for a hospital source.

CandidateOut.title: CandidateOut
CandidateOut.description:
What the requester's org sees of a source: no batch ids, raw stock figures or, for a
hospital source, cost (it would reveal that hospital's unit cost; CLAUDE.md rule 6).

observed_value.title: Observed Value
observed_value.description: EXCURSION / RECOVERED: the reading (°C) that completed the run of consecutive readings. DEVICE_SILENT: seconds without a reading when it was noticed.

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.description: EXCURSION / RECOVERED: the band's bound (°C) the excursion crossed. DEVICE_SILENT: the silence limit in seconds.

ts.title: Ts
ts.description: The reading that completed the run, or when the silence was noticed.

band.description: The product's allowed range; both null: no rule.

device.description: The cold box on the shipment, or the one that sent its newest reading.

silent_after_seconds.title: Silent After Seconds
silent_after_seconds.description: A device silent this long while IN_TRANSIT raises DEVICE_SILENT.

has_excursion.title: Has Excursion
has_excursion.description: An EXCURSION is on record (it stays after RECOVERED).

ColdChainSummary.title: ColdChainSummary
ColdChainSummary.description: A shipment's cold-chain state for lists (the dispatch board and Deliveries badges).

open_shortfall_qty.title: Open Shortfall Qty
open_shortfall_qty.description: Sum of the hub-computed shortfall of every other org's shortage for this product that is OPEN, MATCHING or AWAITING_DECISION; 0 when there is none.

DemandOut.title: DemandOut
DemandOut.description:
Open network demand for one product the caller's supplier org offers. Aggregated over
every hospital: no hospital, facility, shortage or count of either (CLAUDE.md rule 6).

shipment_id.title: Shipment Id
shipment_id.description: The shipment the device rides with; null takes it off its shipment.

excess.title: Excess
excess.description: on_hand - safety stock - forecast usage, rounded down.

suggested_qty.title: Suggested Qty
suggested_qty.description: What "Offer to network" posts: the excess, never more than transferable.

surplus_post_id.title: Surplus Post Id
surplus_post_id.description: The batch's live (OPEN or MATCHED) surplus post, if any.

ExpiryRiskOut.title: ExpiryRiskOut
ExpiryRiskOut.description: A batch whose forecast usage before expiry is less than on_hand - safety stock.

lower.title: Lower
lower.description: Lower bound of the 95% prediction interval.

upper.title: Upper
upper.description: Upper bound of the 95% prediction interval.

model_version.title: Model Version
model_version.description: holt-winters-weekly/1, or moving-average-28/1 under 60 days of history.

synthetic_history.title: Synthetic History
synthetic_history.description: True when the history includes synthetic (seeded) consumption records.

usable_stock.title: Usable Stock
usable_stock.description: On hand less reserved, allocated, quarantined and active holds, over unexpired batches (safety stock is usable by its own hospital).

stockout_date.title: Stockout Date
stockout_date.description: The first day cumulative forecast use exceeds usable stock; null if it does not within the stored forecast.

ForecastOut.title: ForecastOut
ForecastOut.description: One product's stored forecast against the caller's org's stock now.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why the shipment cannot be in this route, in plain words.

ts.title: Ts
ts.description: When the phone took the fix; the hub's time if left out.

MatchReason.title: MatchReason
MatchReason.description:
Why the post was matched to the caller's org: its own open shortage of the product,
or its own forecast stock-out within 14 days.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: "No eligible source" when nothing is eligible.

payload.title: Payload
payload.description: recommendation.escalated: recommendation_id, shortage_id, escalated_by, reason (null if none was typed), expires_at.

OfferIn.title: OfferIn
OfferIn.description: One offer per PUT, keyed by the caller's org and `product_id` (upsert).

shipment_ids.title: Shipment Ids
shipment_ids.description: Unassigned (CREATED) shipments the caller's org may see; repeats count once.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA time zone for the times in the reasons, e.g. Asia/Kolkata.

vehicle_id.title: Vehicle Id
vehicle_id.description: Optional: with a vehicle without cold chain, cold-chain shipments are reported infeasible.

Outcome.title: Outcome
Outcome.description:
CONFIRMED: the shortage's shortfall was accepted in full. PARTIAL: less was accepted,
and a residual shortage was opened for the rest.

landed_cost_paise.title: Landed Cost Paise
landed_cost_paise.description: Supplier lines only, as for candidates.

alternatives.title: Alternatives
alternatives.description: The best BUY, or for a BUY the next one.

parallel.title: Parallel
parallel.description: CRITICAL TRANSFER only (S19): the single-source candidates asked at once, the planned line first; the first to accept wins. Empty for every other plan.

score.title: Score
score.description: 0-1; 1.0 = the phrase is the name, code or a synonym.

matched_on.title: Matched On
matched_on.description: The name, code or synonym that scored best.

ProductMatchOut.title: ProductMatchOut
ProductMatchOut.description: One catalog product the search phrase may name (S17), with how well it scored.

ProductSearchOut.title: ProductSearchOut
ProductSearchOut.description:
Best first; products scoring under the search's minimum are left out. The search ranks
and never picks: callers must ask the user when scores are close (apps-ai-iot.md).

PublicOrgView.title: PublicOrgView
PublicOrgView.description: What any org may see of another org: name, type, location only.

shipment_id.title: Shipment Id
shipment_id.description: Set once the order is dispatched.

PurchaseOrderOut.title: PurchaseOrderOut
PurchaseOrderOut.description: A purchase order as the supplier it was sent to sees it.

ReadingIn.title: ReadingIn
ReadingIn.description: One reading as the cold box publishes it (apps-ai-iot.md, Firmware).

inspection_note.title: Inspection Note
inspection_note.description: Required (400) when a cold-chain EXCURSION is on record for the shipment, even one since RECOVERED (`inspection_note_required` on the shipment).

expiry_date.title: Expiry Date
expiry_date.description: The expiry printed on the accepted stock. Required (400) when accepted > 0: the accepted stock becomes a new batch in the receiver's inventory.

batch_no.title: Batch No
batch_no.description: The new batch's number; `RCV-` and the shipment id's first 8 characters if left out. A batch number already used for this product at the facility is 409.

ReceiptIn.title: ReceiptIn
ReceiptIn.description:
What the receiver counted. `expected` is the shipment's qty (read-only; sending it is
a 422). Invariants (business-rules.md §9), else 400: received ≤ expected and accepted +
rejected = received.

batch_id.title: Batch Id
batch_id.description: The receiver's new inventory batch holding the accepted stock.

reconciliation.description: Null until every shipment of the shortage has a receipt.

ReceiptOut.title: ReceiptOut
ReceiptOut.description: Seen by the receiving org only.

shelf_life_days.title: Shelf Life Days
shelf_life_days.description: Hospital sources: days of shelf life left at delivery on the held stock.

landed_cost_paise.title: Landed Cost Paise
landed_cost_paise.description: Supplier sources only; always null for a hospital source.

RecommendationLineOut.title: RecommendationLineOut
RecommendationLineOut.description:
One source of a recommendation as the requester's org sees it. A hospital source's
landed cost is never shown: it is quantity x that hospital's unit cost + transport + a
2% handling fee, and transport follows from the two public locations, so any cost figure
for a hospital line would reveal its unit cost (CLAUDE.md rule 6).

alternatives.title: Alternatives
alternatives.description: The best BUY for a transfer, or for a BUY the next supplier.

total_landed_cost_paise.title: Total Landed Cost Paise
total_landed_cost_paise.description: BUY only (supplier lines); null whenever a hospital source is involved.

explanation.title: Explanation
explanation.description: Built by the hub from the stored candidate data.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: What the decider typed, or a timer's cause; null if nothing was typed.

outcome.description: The shortage's: CONFIRMED (shortfall accepted in full, RESOLVED) or PARTIAL (PARTIALLY_RESOLVED, residual opened).

has_history.title: Has History
has_history.description: False while the score is the no-history default (some component has no history yet).

response_speed.title: Response Speed
response_speed.description: max(0, 1 - median response time ÷ the response limit).

on_time_rate.title: On Time Rate
on_time_rate.description: Share of delivered shipments delivered by the shortage's deadline.

discrepancy_rate.title: Discrepancy Rate
discrepancy_rate.description: Units not accepted ÷ units expected, over reconciled shipments.

credits.title: Credits
credits.description: The org's credit balance (§12, not spendable yet); the caller's own org only, null for any other org.

ReliabilityOut.title: ReliabilityOut
ReliabilityOut.description:
An org's stored reliability (business-rules.md §12). Components are null while the
org has no history for them; the score is then the no-history default (70).

lead_time_days.title: Lead Time Days
lead_time_days.description: The shortest supplier lead time for the product in whole days (rounded up), or the default (7) when no supplier offers it.

qty.title: Qty
qty.description: Forecast lead-time demand + safety stock - usable stock, rounded up, never below 0.

assigned_shipment_ids.title: Assigned Shipment Ids
assigned_shipment_ids.description: The feasible shipments, now ASSIGNED to the driver, in pickup order.

RoutePlanOut.title: RoutePlanOut
RoutePlanOut.description:
A stop order for one driver: every pickup before its drop, every drop by its
shortage's `required_by`, every cold-chain shipment within the cold-chain ride limit.
Shipments that cannot fit are in `infeasible`, never left out silently.

RouteProvider.title: RouteProvider
RouteProvider.description: Which provider gave a stored route: OSRM, or the haversine fallback (§4).

coldchain.description: The newest cold-chain event the caller may see, and whether an excursion is on record (S15); null when there is none.

route_geometry.title: Route Geometry
route_geometry.description: GeoJSON LineString ([lng, lat] pairs) of the road route; null until assigned.

inspection_note_required.title: Inspection Note Required
inspection_note_required.description: True when a cold-chain excursion is on record for the shipment, even one that has since recovered: its receipt then needs an inspection note (business-rules.md §9, §11).

receipt.description: What the receiving org recorded (with the reconciliation once every shipment of the shortage has a receipt). Shown to the receiving org only; null for the other orgs and before a receipt.

coldchain.description: The newest cold-chain event the caller may see, and whether an excursion is on record (S15); null when there is none.

ShipmentOut.title: ShipmentOut
ShipmentOut.description:
What every involved org sees: no costs. `planned_eta` is the plan's estimate at
approval; `eta` and the route are computed at assignment (null while unassigned).

source.description: Where the user filled it in: FORM, or CHAT for a chat draft the user checked and confirmed on its card (S17). The AI service never calls this.

status.title: Status
status.description: OPEN (the default) starts matching at once. DRAFT saves it unmatched until the requester confirms it (POST /shortages/{id}/confirm; business-rules §8).

ShortageCreate.title: ShortageCreate
ShortageCreate.description:
Any unknown field is a 422, except `shortfall`: the hub computes it
(business-rules.md §1), so a client value is accepted and ignored.

shortfall.title: Shortfall
shortfall.description: Hub-computed max(0, qty_required - qty_local_usable); never taken as input.

sla_deadline.title: Sla Deadline
sla_deadline.description: When the source must accept or decline.

hold_expires_at.title: Hold Expires At
hold_expires_at.description: When the tentative holds lapse unless the requester decides.

held_qty.title: Held Qty
held_qty.description: Units under active (TENTATIVE or FIRM) holds.

holds.title: Holds
holds.description: Source org only; null for the requester.

responded_by.title: Responded By
responded_by.description: The source org user who answered. Source org only; null for the requester.

reason_source.title: Reason Source
reason_source.description: On a decline: USER if the source typed a reason, else SYSTEM.

SourceRequestOut.title: SourceRequestOut
SourceRequestOut.description:
Both orgs see the request itself. Only the source org sees which of its batches are
held (`holds`) and which of its users answered (`responded_by`); the requester sees
the total (`held_qty`) and the hold deadline.

status.description: The next state: PICKED_UP, IN_TRANSIT or DELIVERED, one step at a time.

ticket.title: Ticket
ticket.description: Pass as `?ticket=` to GET /events/stream (EventSource cannot send headers).

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: Open the stream before this; it lasts 60 seconds.

SurplusCreate.title: SurplusCreate
SurplusCreate.description:
Offer one of the caller's org's batches to the network. `qty` may not exceed the
batch's transferable now; afterwards the post offers only up to its current
transferable (CLAUDE.md rule 4).

offered_qty.title: Offered Qty
offered_qty.description: Never more than the batch's current transferable.

SurplusOfferOut.title: SurplusOfferOut
SurplusOfferOut.description:
Another org's post as a matched org sees it: transferable qty, expiry band and
location only (CLAUDE.md rule 6). No batch, expiry date, price or stock figures.

offered_qty.title: Offered Qty
offered_qty.description: What the network is offered now: qty, never more than the batch's current hub-computed transferable (0 once the batch has expired).

matched_org_ids.title: Matched Org Ids
matched_org_ids.description: The orgs it was matched to (each got `surplus.matched`).

SurplusOut.title: SurplusOut
SurplusOut.description: The poster's own view of its post.

duplicates.title: Duplicates
duplicates.description: Readings already stored (same device_id and ts).

unknown_devices.title: Unknown Devices
unknown_devices.description: device_ids with no Device; not stored.

VerifyIn.title: VerifyIn
VerifyIn.description: `method` is required: the hub records only the count method the user stated.

secret.title: Secret
secret.description: Shown only now. Verify `X-CareE-Signature: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body>` with it.
